header: Three things a first document pipeline needs
description: A year of the Build plan, table extraction and two days of migration work in one order. Bought separately, the three cost EUR 2,480.

items.name: Build plan, 12 months
items.description_text: 5,000 pages a month, then EUR 0.010 per page. Support answers the next business day.

items.name: Table extraction add-on, 12 months
items.description_text: Returns column headers, line items and totals from scanned tables as JSON, not as loose text.

items.name: Migration review, two days
items.description_text: An engineer maps your current templates to endpoints and delivers a working extraction schema.
